A.studentGoal: I can listen and point to a picture.

info.headline: I can listen and point to a picture.
info.summary: One word or one short sentence, read aloud by the device or a grown-up.
canDo: I can listen and point to a picture.

activities.title: Find the Seed
vocabulary: a tiny thing a plant grows from

activities.hint: Tap 'Hear it again' as many times as you want. Tap the speaker on a picture to hear its name.
activities.support: Tap 'Hear it again' as many times as you want. Tap the speaker on a picture to hear its name.
activities.extension: Tell a grown-up one more thing that happened in the story.
wida: Identify a named object from oral input

teacher.use: With a grown-up beside the child. The grown-up may tap the speaker, point, and repeat; the child answers by pointing or saying a word.
teacher.lower: Play the story twice. Point to each picture choice as the player names it. Accept a pointed answer.
teacher.onLevel: Play once, let the child choose, then ask them to say the answer in a short sentence.
teacher.challenge: After the answer, ask a why or what-next question about the story.
teacher.noTech: Read the script aloud from the teacher packet and hold up picture cards for the choices.
teacher.prompt: What did you hear that helped you choose?

activities.title: Wash Your Hands
activities.directions: Listen. Tap what helps you clean your hands.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha. Toca lo que te ayuda a limpiarte las manos.

jabón: lo que frotas en las manos para limpiarlas

B.studentGoal: I can listen for sounds, rhymes and two things.

canDo: I can listen for sounds, rhymes and two things.

activities.title: What Rhymes with Cat?
activities.directions: Listen. Tap the picture that rhymes.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha. Toca el dibujo que rima.
activities.script: Words that rhyme sound the same at the end. Cat, hat. Now listen. Which one rhymes with cat: hat, dog, or sun?
vocabulary: words that sound the same at the end
rima: palabras que suenan igual al final
something you wear on your head
sombrero: algo que te pones en la cabeza
activities.correct: Cat and hat rhyme. They end with the same sound.

activities.title: Clap the Parts
activities.skill: Counting the parts of a word
activities.directions: Listen. Clap for each part of the word. Tap how many claps.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha. Aplaude cada parte de la palabra. Toca cuántos aplausos.
activities.script: Clap with me. Ba, na, na. Banana has parts. Clap, clap, clap. How many claps did we make?
vocabulary: aplaudir: golpear las manos una con otra
activities.correct: Ba-na-na has three parts, so three claps.

activities.title: The Bird Chant
activities.skill: Listening to a chant for a count
activities.directions: Listen to the chant. Tap what the chant is about.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha la rima. Toca de qué trata.
activities.prompt: Which animal is in the chant?
activities.script: Quack, quack, down the lane. Splash, splash, in the rain. One yellow duck swims, swims, swims. Quack, quack, here it comes!
vocabulary: a bird that swims and says quack
pato: ave que nada y dice cuac
activities.correct: Quack, quack. The chant is about a duck.

activities.title: What Max Sees at Night
activities.directions: Listen. Tap two things Max sees. There are two answers.
activities.directionsEs: Escucha. Toca dos cosas que ve Max. Hay dos respuestas.
activities.prompt: What does Max see? Tap two.
activities.script: It is night. Max looks out the window. He sees the round moon. He sees many stars. He does not see the sun.
vocabulary: the dark time when we sleep
noche: el tiempo oscuro en que dormimos
a tiny light far away in the sky
estrella: una lucecita lejana en el cielo
activities.correct: At night Max sees the moon and the stars.
